definition: Unique identifier for one archived recording
City in which the recording was made (24 cities)
Biome band: temperate, tropical or arid
Decimal degrees; used to compute solar times
Species label for the recorded bird (30 species)
Body mass in grams; controls the allometric frequency baseline
Modelled road-traffic noise at the site (dB)
VIIRS night-time radiance (nW/cm2/sr)
Urban heat island intensity, degrees above the rural baseline
Month of recording (3-6, the breeding season)
Air temperature at the site
Recording device class; controls instrument bias
Minimum song frequency (Hz)
Dominant song frequency (Hz)
Spectral bandwidth (Hz)
Mean note duration (ms)
Syllables per second
Dawn-song onset relative to sunrise (negative = before)
Vocal cessation relative to sunset (positive = after)
Songs per minute; how much the bird sings (NEW in Week 3)
Estimated noise floor of the file; used for quality screening
